subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusions is/are definitely TRUE from the statement.

Statement: P > Q T = R ≥ U > V

Conclusion I: V T

options.text: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II are True
Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II is True

solution:
**Given:**

Statement: P > Q T = R ≥ U > V

**Formula used:**

Basic inequality chain comparison

**Calculation:**

P > Q

S > Q

S > T

T = R

R ≥ U

U > V

⇒ S > T = R ≥ U > V

⇒ S > V

⇒ V Q and S > T

No direct relation between P and T

⇒ P > T cannot be determined ✘

**Conclusion II is NOT definitely TRUE.**

**∴ Only Conclusion I is TRUE.**

43:T
